description: Main application code for a multistroke gesture recognition demo using Kivy framework. It manages UI screens, gesture recognition, and database interactions.

classes.name: MainMenu
classes.description: A placeholder class for the main menu layout.

classes.name: MultistrokeAppSettings
classes.description: A settings container class for the application, extending MultistrokeSettingsContainer.

classes.name: MultistrokeApp
classes.description: Main application class managing gesture recognition, UI screens, and interactions.

methods.name: goto_database_screen
methods.description: Switches to the database screen after importing gesture database.

methods.name: handle_gesture_cleanup
methods.description: Removes gesture result label from surface after gesture cleanup.

methods.name: handle_gesture_discard
methods.description: Displays a discard message when a gesture is discarded.

methods.name: handle_gesture_complete
methods.description: Recognizes a gesture and binds completion handler.

methods.name: handle_recognize_complete
methods.description: Processes recognition result, updates history, and displays match info.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes and constructs the main UI layout, screens, and bindings.
